decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins sit at the core of the firm's data integration expertise and standards work, so in-house R&D can keep absorbing user feedback and extending the line.

The building digital twin service fits the strategy of integrating geospatial IT with enterprise systems, but it rests on a newer BIM-oriented knowledge base and is only briefly mentioned on the website, so its position stays less secure.

With the standalone authentication service withdrawn, the GIS-specific identity and access service is the natural home for the firm's identity know-how, building directly on its platform integration knowledge.
The consulting workshop has its own page and draws on decades of consulting experience and certified trainers, so it needs few resources and feeds customer knowledge back into the firm's development.
